description:
Read, write, delete, lease, list, or ingest structured state slices into shared behavior tree blackboard state (actions: get, set, delete, lease, list, ingest_slice). Use manage_blackboard instead of set_parameters when coordinating state across behavior nodes, projecting perception/spatial slices with staleness protection, or acquiring agent mutex leases.

Returns blackboard value, lease acquisition status, key listings, or slice ingestion summary with expiry metadata.

action.description: Blackboard operation: get, set, delete, lease, list, ingest_slice

mode.description: Lease action mode: acquire or release (default: acquire)

payload.description: Key-value dictionary of slice data to project into blackboard (action: ingest_slice)

ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live before slice expires and is marked stale (default: 5000ms)

name: manage_blackboard
